adapter_provenance.method: Independent dispositions and dimension rationales copied unchanged; source paths bound to evidence IDs

reliability.rationale: All saved predictions and primary metrics independently reproduce from source-verified inputs, including unfavorable alternatives. The target is withheld pixels on the same daily temperature-anomaly map with explicit neighboring-pixel calibration. Spatial interpolation gains do not test future climate, independently measured water temperature or bleaching outcomes.

mechanism.rationale: Computational agreement cannot identify a physical or causal mechanism. novelty.rationale: This review checks computation and information access; targeted literature records are not independent priority adjudication.

significance.rationale: Reusable scoped comparison and preserved falsification evidence. impact.rationale: No deployed intervention, operational saving, clinical qualification or independently measured safety benefit is established.
